data.title: Aurel1A Residence
data.about:
Aurel1A Residence by Object 1 is an upcoming development located at Dubai Sports City, one of the city’s fastest-growing neighborhoods, offering residents a unique blend of sports-centric and urban living. Offering a selection of studios, as well as studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, Aurel1A Residence apartments cater to diverse lifestyles and preferences. Luxury apartments at Aurel1A Residence by Object 1 are designed with exceptional quality and elegance, promising residents a premium living experience.

There are 24 floors in the building, along with four parking levels. Aurel1A Residence by Object 1 is near top-tier sports facilities and reputable schools, enhancing both convenience and leisure for residents.

Real estate at Aurel1A Residence by Object 1 offers an unrivaled opportunity to reside in one of Dubai's most vibrant communities. Experience the harmonious blend of modern architecture and natural beauty at the luxury Aurel1A Residence by Object 1, where an aspirational lifestyle awaits.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Smart Home Automation: Enjoy cutting-edge smart lock technology and home automation controls.
  • Luxurious Lobby: Welcoming and elegant lobby area designed to impress.
  • Family-Oriented Facilities, including Indoor kids' playroom, outdoor kids' play area for active, and a dedicated kids' pool for keeping the little ones busy the whole day.
  • Diverse Apartment Selection: Offers a range of studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments to suit various lifestyles and preferences.
  • Strategic Location in Dubai Sports City: Provides easy access to premier sporting venues, including the Dubai International Cricket Stadium and The Els Golf Club.
  • Sports-Centric Lifestyle: Ideal for sports enthusiasts, with access to top-tier sports facilities and fitness amenities.
  • Designed for Modern Living: Apartments are crafted with exceptional quality and elegance, ensuring a premium living experience.

Surrounded by iconic landmarks like the Dubai International Cricket Stadium and The Els Golf Club, this prime location provides easy access to top-tier Aurel1A Residence amenities by Object 1. Designed with modern sophistication, Aurel1A Residence apartments make it a premier choice in Dubai real estate for those seeking elegance and comfort.

  • 5 Minutes to Dubai International Cricket Stadium
  • 8 Minutes to The Els Golf Club
  • 10 Minutes to ICC Academy
  • 15 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 20 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
